title: Household Income and Expenditure: States
description: This dataset tabulates household-level income, expenditure, poverty, and income inequality at state level. It is based on the Household Income & Expenditure Surveys (HIES) carried in 2022.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as this is annual data

fields.name: income_mean
fields.title: Mean Income
fields.description: [Integer] Average (across households) gross monthly household income, in RM

fields.name: income_median
fields.title: Median Income
fields.description: [Integer] Median (across households) gross monthly household income, in RM

fields.name: expenditure_mean
fields.title: Mean Expenditure
fields.description: [Integer] Average (across households) gross monthly household expenditure, in RM

fields.name: gini
fields.title: Gini Coefficient
fields.description: [Float] Gini coefficient, with higher values indicating greater inequality of income between households

fields.name: poverty
fields.title: Poverty Rate
fields.description: [Float] Proportion of households with monthly income below the Poverty Line Income (PLI)

methodology: This data is is based on Household Income Surveys (HIS) and Household Income & Expenditure Surveys (HIES) carried out from 1970 to 2024, the latest of which is HIES 2022. The survey is carried out at least twice in a rolling five-year period to produce representative data regarding income, poverty and access to basic amenities for Malaysian households.
caveat: For a full account of the relative standard errors for the survey as well as the detailed survey methodology, please refer to the [HIES Technical Notes](https://storage.googleapis.com/dosm-public-publications/technote_hies_income_en.pdf).
